text.p: Fiorentina beat Benfica 2-0 in the away leg of their European Cup Winners' Cup quarter-final on Thursday to take a giant step towards the semifinals.

Argentine striker Gabriel Batistuta, who came into the game out of form in the Italian league, scored with a spectacular volley in the dying seconds to give Fiorentina a comfortable lead to take into the second leg in two weeks.
Batistuta laid on the first goal for fellow striker Francisco Baiano, slipping the ball to him on the edge of the box on the stroke of halftime. Baiano made no mistake with his right-foot shot.
Although Benfica had pushed forward in the second half, they found it difficult to break down a resilient Fiorentina defence.
